name: Automotive
description: Vehicle diagnostics and sealed harness connectors: OBD-II type-A plug and receptacle with a 16-pin extension example; generic sealed 3-way connectors; TE DEUTSCH DT04/DT06 2- and 6-way housings, size-16 contacts, sealing plug and secondary locks. All connectors have generated 3D envelopes, with dimensions and approximations cited; OBD-II and generic sealed connectors include original mating and rear artwork. Existing CAN, K/L-line, J1850 vocabulary, sensor profiles and crimp examples remain.
